eventStreams.name: EDPatientFlow
eventStreams.description: Real-time ED triage events — patient arrivals, triage scores, wait times, and dispositions
kqlAggregations: EDPatientFlowEvents | summarize PatientCount=count(), AvgWait=avg(WaitMinutes), TraumaCount=countif(IsTrauma) by FacilityID, AcuityLevel, bin(Timestamp, 15m)
EDPatientFlowEvents | summarize Arrivals=countif(EventType == 'Arrival'), Discharges=countif(EventType == 'Discharge') by FacilityID, bin(Timestamp, 1h)

eventStreams.name: BedStatusUpdates
eventStreams.description: Real-time bed admission, discharge, and transfer events across all facilities
kqlAggregations: BedStatusEvents | summarize Admissions=countif(EventType == 'Admission'), Discharges=countif(EventType == 'Discharge'), Transfers=countif(EventType == 'Transfer') by FacilityID, Unit, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
BedStatusEvents | where NewStatus == 'Occupied' | summarize OccupiedCount=dcount(BedID) by FacilityID, Unit, bin(Timestamp, 15m)

eventStreams.name: VitalSignsStream
eventStreams.description: Continuous patient vital signs monitoring from bedside devices
kqlAggregations: VitalSignsStreamEvents | summarize AvgHR=avg(HeartRate), AvgSpO2=avg(SpO2), AlertCount=countif(IsAlert) by PatientID, bin(Timestamp, 5m)
VitalSignsStreamEvents | where IsAlert == true | summarize AlertCount=count() by FacilityID, bin(Timestamp, 15m)

bridgeQueries.name: PatientFlowBridge
bridgeQueries.description: Bridge hot ED flow events with cold Lakehouse encounter data

bridgeQueries.name: BedCensusBridge
bridgeQueries.description: Bridge hot bed status with cold census data
